title: The Majestic Support – The Leading-Edge Help Desk & Customer Support Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to…
description: The Majestic Support WordPress plugin up to version 1.2.4 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'mjsupport_message' parameter. This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when a staff member or administrator interacts with the injected content. Exploitation requires an administrator to click a crafted link on the ticket detail screen, as the payload triggers on click rather than page load.
